readerCopy.body: Praise can expose the difference between being valued and being valued only for the version that stays easy to approve of. When the Sun conjoins Lilith, identity and autonomy fuse, making recognition harder to separate from what has been left out in order to receive it. Dependability, polish, agreement, or likability can be genuine strengths and still become expensive if success requires anger, difference, desire, or objection to stay hidden. Appreciation becomes more trustworthy when it can survive a fuller version of the person receiving it.
